notes.title: Demo Update #4 - Music + Gameplay
notes.content:
Hey!
[p align="start"]Just pushed a new build with a few changes I’m quite excited about:

The game’s a bit harder now — matches should be a tiny bit more challenging.

Tenzio (the purple team) got a revamp - they should be more dynamic now.

Added a stat wheel to the upgrade screen so it’s easier to see your build.

Trying to find a cool vibe with some new music.

Opponent AI should be playing a little smarter (we’ll see…).
[p align="start"]That’s the gist of it — thanks for playing and let me know how it feels!

notes.title: Demo Update #3 - Locker room + controller support
notes.content:
Big update for the demo today! Thanks to everyone who’s been playing and sending feedback — this one makes the game smoother, clearer, and (hopefully) more fun to play.
[p align="start"]Here’s what’s new:

Upgraded Locker Room – new look and flow between matches.

Rebalanced Gameplay – matches now feel tighter and more competitive.

More Intuitive Spike Aiming – spiking feels natural and responsive.

Controller Support – grab your gamepad and hit the court! (this is my first time trying controller support, if it doesn't work tell me ASAP!)
[p align="start"]This version is a huge step toward the final feel of Hangtime! and I’m excited for you to try it out.
[p align="start"]👉 Play the demo now & don’t forget to wishlist to support development!

notes.title: Demo Update #2 - Features + fixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thanks so much for all the feedback on the Hangtime! demo so far — I’ve been listening closely, and today’s update brings a bunch of improvements and fixes to make rallies smoother than ever.
🔧 What’s new:
Bugs squashed – cleaned up some pesky issues causing weird moments in matches.

Achievements added – start collecting your bragging rights!

Sound settings menu – adjust the game to your perfect vibe.

Camera fixed (again!) – no more funny business, it should behave properly now.

AI setter improved – he covers tips!!

Rebalancing
[p align="start"]This is just the beginning — controller support and more are coming soon 👀.
[p align="start"]Thanks for playing and keep spiking those wishlists!

notes.title: Update #1: qol upgrades
notes.content:
